verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers self-hosted deployment and a confirmed local pip-installable runtime (own infra, own LLM keys), which an AI-native user could use to stand up an isolated instance away from any production/cloud data. However, there is no explicit sandbox/test-mode feature, staging API keys, or documented separation between test and production data flows. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode API distinct from self-hosting, explicit guidance on isolating test runs from production data, and independent confirmation that self-hosted runs are data-isolated from Skyvern's cloud.
